steps.name: The Boy Whose Name Is Called
steps.objective: Watch someone's conversation in front of the 「Hill Windmill」 in 「Whispering Hill」, then press the [Complete Quest] button to finish the quest.

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Grand Duke, wait.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: You managed to find me.

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: It wasn't hard.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Do you not resent me, boy? All I have done is use you.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Well, thanks to you, I found what I needed.

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: How long until the day you've been waiting for?

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: So that is what you wished to know. It will be 'soon.'

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: I want to help.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: And how would you do that?

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: There is nothing you could do where I am going... The moment you set foot there, you would vanish without a scrap of flesh remaining...

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: That is why there is someone else I must summon...

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: What are you looking at?

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: A flower grown from a seed I took out of the mirror and planted. Cold, yet warm.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: I do not know whether I will be betrayed again, but that will hardly be possible there...
(Barbatos plucks the flower and tucks it inside his coat.)

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Turning me down with riddles, huh? Fine. So are you going to become a god now?

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: I was a god from the beginning. This form I now wear...

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: What a bother to explain. If you truly wish to help me, stay quietly in hiding. And try not to die before we meet again, nameless boy.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: I cannot keep calling you 'nameless boy' forever... Allow me to give you a gift.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: The name of someone who was as fine a warrior as Atalante.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Thank you... Meleager.
(Barbatos pats No Name on the shoulder, leaps onto the windmill, and vanishes as though flying into the sky.)

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Just when I think I understand that man... Oh, he's not a man. Not a demon, either...

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Meleager... Meleager... A little hard to pronounce, but I think I could get used to it.

steps.name: Help Needed
steps.objective: Watch the story of a visitor who has come to see [Caluso] in 「Invernel Ruins」, then press the [Complete Quest] button to finish the quest.

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: Who's there?

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: It's me, Lydia. Caluso, I told you to stop swinging your fists at everything.

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: You blocked it with your Magic Rod well enough. Stop complaining... What brings our busy demigod here? Daniel and Romalius should be in the village.

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: This is more important than checking on those two. I need your help, Caluso.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: It's an honor to meet you, sir.

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: No need for that. What is so serious that you've brought a Dokkalf priest along?

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: Caluso, this is Askren, the Immortal Priesthood's ace and its youngest fifth-rank priest.

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: A workaholic, then. How much work did you do to reach the fifth rank already?

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: Priest Askren, this is Caluso, the legendary battle priest famed for slaying ten thousand magical beasts.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Ten thousand magical beasts? That's incredible. I'm too scared to lay a hand on one...

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: Askren, quiet.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Yes...

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: If you're gathering people like this, it must be something serious...

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: Lady Iris has delivered an oracle to %s.

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: What do you need me to do?

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: Lend us your strength.

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: Very well.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: You aren't going to ask anything else, sir?

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: Unlike a certain someone with less substance than air.

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: I won't ask for more, but I should at least know where we're going.

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: All right. I'll tell you. Our destination is...

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: Linford, a fragment of the Celestial Realm known as the City of Angels.
